description: This file defines data classes and a parser for 'TalkDirective' configuration objects in JSON format, enabling extraction of voice and speech parameters from text inputs.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various configurable parameters for speech synthesis directives, such as voice ID, speed, style, and language.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Holds the output of parsing a directive, including the directive object, the remaining text, and any unknown keys encountered.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Object that provides a method to parse text into a TalkDirective, extracting configuration from JSON-formatted strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse input text for a JSON directive configuration and extract it into a TalkDirective object.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Helper method to parse a line into a JsonObject.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Utility to extract a string value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Utility to extract a double value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Utility to extract an integer value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.

methods.name: longValue
methods.description: Utility to extract a long value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Utility to extract a boolean value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.
